initial.name: run_code
initial.description: Execute a Python program against the available tools. Takes two required arguments: `code`, the program to execute, and `description`, a short summary of what the program does. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Curate the program output. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run. The program is the body of an async Python function. Top-level await and return are supported. Emit output with print(...) or return a lossless JSON value. Only printed values and the returned value become program output. Each call runs in a fresh Python process; variables and imported modules do not persist across calls. The working directory is the Session's current directory.

code.description: The Python program to execute, following this tool's execution instructions.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this program does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "Count TODO markers across packages"; "Read failing test and its fixture"; "Rename config key in every cordis.yml".
